subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw add a separate core AI-safety taxonomy/dashboard with its own retention contract, or should safety signals remain a typed projection of the existing diagnostics stability and exporter surfaces?
rationale: The choice creates a new core schema, plugin SDK contract, operator UI, CLI namespace, persistence owner, and sensitive-data policy; code review cannot safely choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Consolidate with diagnostics
options.body: Extend the existing sanitized diagnostics stability recorder, protocol, CLI, and UI, adding SQLite retention only after its operator and privacy contract is approved.

options.title: Sponsor a separate subsystem
options.body: Approve a distinct safety subsystem and require a documented schema, access/redaction policy, shared-SQLite lifecycle, upgrade contract, and end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the stacked series
options.body: Keep the tracking issue open but close or pause the implementation PRs until a maintainer-sponsored architecture is available.

recommendation.title: Consolidate with diagnostics
recommendation.body: Extend the existing sanitized diagnostics stability recorder, protocol, CLI, and UI, adding SQLite retention only after its operator and privacy contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a cross-cutting core product and architecture boundary spanning Gateway protocol, CLI, UI, storage, diagnostics, and plugin API ownership.
